outcome: #592 fixed: the MCP Metrics/Results tool accepts every valid Metrics and can remove stale panels
owner_impact: While fixing the audited Experiments through the connector, its fine-grained Metrics/Results tool refused Experiments whose Metrics read robot state, traits or the field (for example the corrected Firat aggregation), even though whole-Experiment edits accepted them, and it could not delete a Results panel that pointed to a removed metric. Both are fixed in connector version 3.28.0; the authoring language is unchanged. Test now: optional. In ChatGPT or Claude, ask the connector to read the Results of the Firat aggregation Experiment; it now answers instead of reporting 'unknown agent private scientific state'.

next.text: #592 is closed. The audit fixes are in the collection 'Audit fixes — 26 Sep 2026 (to check)' for your review.

technical_evidence: authoring.js exports metricsCompileContext(artifacts): best-effort per artifact, same shape as whole-Experiment validation (shared metricsContext helper); results-authoring.js uses it for read, create/update/remove metric.

mutateResultsPanels drops references to metrics that no longer exist before an edit; remove_panel checks the saved panels, so a stale panel can be removed; unknown metrics in a new panel are still rejected.
Two new tests fail on the previous code and pass now; web tests 723 pass. MCP server 3.28.0, contract vlab.authoring/0.17 unchanged.
